title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Withdrawal Notice, End of Care and Credit-Balance Refunds
content:
**Notice.** A family ends Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program care by written withdrawal notice, which the support desk records as a withdrawal notice request. The withdrawal itself is the family's own action.

**Clauses no longer in force.** The following former clauses are **no longer in force**. They are superseded by the current basis for the notice period and for crediting the final billed month.

- The clause that the last day of care is the requested last day, but that when the requested last day is earlier than the withdrawal notice period after the notice was received, tuition is billed through the end of that notice period, the notice date counting as day 0.
- The clause that a billing month any day of which falls on or before the later of the requested last day and the end of the notice period is billed in full, and that a tuition charge already posted for a month falling entirely after that later date is credited in full as a notice-period adjustment.

**District withdrawal.** When the student withdraws from the district, care ends on the district withdrawal date and the notice period does not apply.

**Credit-balance refunds.** A closed enrollment whose credits and payments exceed its charges is refunded by district check within the refund period of calendar days after its end date. A refund is issued only on an enrollment in status withdrawn, dismissed or ended, as the program's enrollment record shows.

**Balances.** The registration fee is never refunded. An enrollment withdrawn with an unpaid balance keeps that balance owed.

## Figures by plan

| Figure (same on all six Creek Kids Club plans) | Value |
|---|---|
| Withdrawal notice period | 14 calendar days |
| Billing after a short notice | billed through the notice period |
| Credit-balance refund period | within 30 calendar days after the end date |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- An enrollment that ended with charges of 410.00 and payments and credits of 450.00 holds a 40.00 credit balance. It is refunded by district check within 30 calendar days after its end date.
- An active enrollment with a credit balance is not refunded, because a refund is issued only on a withdrawn, dismissed or ended enrollment.
- An enrollment withdrawn with 85.00 unpaid keeps the 85.00 owed.

superseded_clauses: The last day of care is the requested last day, but when the requested last day is earlier than withdrawal_notice_days calendar days after the notice was received, tuition is billed through the end of that notice period (billing_after_short_notice), the notice date counting as day 0.

A billing month any day of which falls on or before the later of the requested last day and the end of the notice period is billed in full; a tuition charge already posted for a month that falls entirely after that later date is credited in full with credit_reason notice_period_adjustment.
